main_measure.name: t of the mean daily sum of forecast x (next-day return - coin mean daily return)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 100 days of cases

decided_by: Fewer than 90% of the active bars are in-profile bars with the close low in its range and a long forecast: the config also takes positions (short or long) where the plan's situation on its long side does not hold.
reading: The plan's situation is read as regime not 'chop' (the profile, as the detector decided it) and the close in the lower half of the day's range ((high-close)/(high-low) >= 0.5), on the long side; the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its 1-bar returns over all windows, and days are UTC calendar days of the bar's timestamp.
